summary: The candidate passes all blocking review gates. A medium contact centralization gap remains, and current HEAD has no www source drift.
current_www_verdict: PASS; no www source drift exists after the candidate.

nonblocking_findings.title: Contact display values are not single-source
nonblocking_findings.context: The contact page displays the email, phone number, and TikTok handle from locale data. The same values also exist in contactDetails.
nonblocking_findings.impact: A configuration change can update links while leaving visible contact values stale.
nonblocking_findings.recommendation: Use contactDetails for raw contact values and keep only translated labels in locale messages.
nonblocking_findings.test_gap: The Phase 4 test checks supportEmail parity but does not check phoneNumber or the TikTok handle.

nonblocking_findings.title: The configured navigation list has no production caller
nonblocking_findings.context: The Header creates a separate localized navigation array. The config navigation export is used by the contact form for productLinks, not by the Header.
nonblocking_findings.impact: Future navigation edits can update the config list without updating the primary Header navigation.
nonblocking_findings.recommendation: Choose one production navigation source and add a caller contract for its Services entry.

nonblocking_findings.title: Focused tests emit existing React DOM warnings
nonblocking_findings.context: The Phase 4 run reports SVG attribute, localized-link scroll, and mocked-image priority warnings.
nonblocking_findings.impact: The warnings do not fail tests, but they reduce diagnostic clarity.
nonblocking_findings.recommendation: Handle these warnings in a later UI cleanup or browser review.
